packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions updates (github-actions datasource) into one tidy PR; helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests keeps them digest-pinned
Group Terraform provider + module updates (terraform datasource) into one PR
Group pre-commit hook updates (pre-commit manager, enabled above) into one PR
Container images managed by Flux - disable Renovate

MetalLB Helm chart (Flux) is on the critical BGP path — it carries every ingress + DNS VIP with no L2 fallback (L24 FRR). Don't auto-merge a bump silently; let it land as a reviewable PR after a settle period (the MetallbBGPAllSessionsDown alert + BGP graceful-restart backstop a bad bump, but a human should sign off).

M122: Flux HelmRelease chart bumps — exact pins now (ranges froze majors; alloy sat 10 minors behind a 0.x cap). Patch+minor grouped weekly; MAJORS as individual PRs for deliberate review (CRDs/breaking changes).
M122: chart MAJORS stay ungrouped — one PR each, hand-reviewed (kube-prometheus-stack majors carry CRD updates; metallb majors risk the BGP/no-L2 path)

M122: raw-manifest images (kubernetes manager on platform/kubernetes/**) previously had ZERO coverage — cephcsi, the CSI sidecars, redis, velero-plugin, unpoller etc. rotted silently. Group the low-risk registry.k8s.io/quay/dockerhub infra sidecars into one settled PR.

M122: authentik server image is governed by the H44 8-hop upgrade PROGRAM (blueprint/schema migrations across the 2024.12→current gap + an unpatched critical RCE window) — NOT a simple renovate bump. Disable so renovate can't tempt an unsafe one-shot merge.

M122: the CNPG operand postgresql image is governed by H45d (cue-db depends on pgvector bundled in the image; CNPG changed extension bundling ~1.30, so a naive minor bump can drop pgvector). Manage via the CNPG cluster CR + a verified image tag, not an auto-PR.
